bottom_line: In UA/NSTEMI CYP2C19 reduced metabolizers, prasugrel vs clopidogrel reduced the composite of CV death, non-fatal MI, or non-fatal stroke (RR 0.57; 95% CI 0.39–0.83).
implications: These integrated TRITON-TIMI 38 estimates support a genotype-dependent difference in comparative efficacy: in UA/NSTEMI CYP2C19 reduced metabolizers the composite endpoint was lower with prasugrel than clopidogrel (RR 0.57; 95% CI 0.39–0.83), while in CYP2C19 extensive metabolizers the composite risks were not substantially different (RR 0.98; 95% CI 0.80–1.20). The document also reports higher overall UA/NSTEMI major or minor bleeding with prasugrel than clopidogrel (RR 1.44; 95% CI 1.19–1.74), so these results do not establish benefit without considering bleeding risk.

major_points.text: This was an exploratory secondary analysis integrating published TRITON-TIMI 38 and genetic substudy results (not individual patient data).
major_points.quote: this study was a secondary analysis that utilized summary relative risk (RR) estimates that have been previously reported rather than individual patient data from the TRITON-TIMI 38 trial.

major_points.text: TRITON-TIMI 38 randomized 13 608 moderate-to-high-risk ACS patients with scheduled PCI to prasugrel vs clopidogrel for 6–15 months.
major_points.quote: The TRITON-TIMI 38 trial randomly assigned 13 608 patients with moderate-to-high-risk ACS with scheduled PCI to receive prasugrel (60-mg loading dose and 10-mg daily maintenance dose) or clopidogrel (300-mg loading dose and 75-mg daily maintenance dose) for 6–15 months [4].

major_points.text: Primary outcome of TRITON-TIMI 38 was the composite of cardiovascular death, non-fatal stroke, and non-fatal MI.
major_points.quote: The primary outcome for the TRITON-TIMI 38 trial was the composite of cardiovascular death, non-fatal stroke, and non-fatal MI events [4].

major_points.text: Most trial participants (approximately 74%) had UA or NSTEMI, with median age 61 years.
major_points.quote: Approximately 74% of the trial participants had UA or NSTEMI, and the median age was 61 years [4].

major_points.text: For UA/NSTEMI overall, the composite endpoint occurred in 9.3% with prasugrel vs 11.2% with clopidogrel (RR 0.82, 95% CI 0.73–0.93).
In UA/NSTEMI CYP2C19 extensive metabolizers, composite risk was similar between prasugrel and clopidogrel (RR 0.98, 95% CI 0.80–1.20).
In UA/NSTEMI CYP2C19 reduced metabolizers, prasugrel lowered composite risk vs clopidogrel (RR 0.57, 95% CI 0.39–0.83).
Safety: UA/NSTEMI major or minor bleeding was higher with prasugrel than clopidogrel overall (5.0% vs 3.5%; RR 1.44, 95% CI 1.19–1.74).

guidelines_referenced.text: National Institute for Health and Clinical Excellence (NICE)
guidelines_referenced.quote: National Institute for Health and Clinical Excellence (NICE) [5] has recommended restricting the use of prasugrel to speciﬁc high-risk groups
Primarily on the basis of this study, prasugrel was approved by the US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) in July 2009

inclusion_criteria.quote: patients with moderate-to-high-risk ACS with scheduled PCI

inclusion_criteria.text: Unstable angina or non-ST segment elevation myocardial infarction scheduled for percutaneous coronary intervention
inclusion_criteria.quote: individuals with unstable angina or non-ST segment elevation myocardial infarction scheduled for percutaneous coronary intervention

criticisms.text: Only a subset (~20%) of TRITON-TIMI 38 was included in the genetic substudy.
criticisms.quote: Only a subset of the TRITON-TIMI 38 population ( 20%), however, was included in the genetic TRITON-TIMI 38 substudy.

criticisms.text: Event rates in the genotyped subset were generally lower than the overall trial, especially for clopidogrel.
criticisms.quote: The event rates in the genotyped subset were generally lower than those reported in the overall trial, particularly for those allocated clopidogrel [4,14,15].

criticisms.text: Published genetic substudy grouped CYP2C19 IMs and PMs as reduced metabolizers, preventing separate estimates.
criticisms.quote: CYP2C19 IMs and PMs were grouped together as CYP2C19 RMs in the published results of the genetic substudy. Consequently, it was not possible to estimate the comparative effects

criticisms.text: No published results for UA vs NSTEMI separately, so equivalence of genotyping utility between subgroups is uncertain.
criticisms.quote: as there are no published results for the comparative efﬁcacy of clopidogrel and prasugrel in the UA and NSTEMI subgroups separately, it is not possible to be certain

criticisms.text: Assumption that genotype hazard ratio estimates from overall ACS do not differ between STEMI and UA/NSTEMI subgroups.
criticisms.quote: Results were reported for a combined ACS population, and it was assumed that this overall estimate does not differ between the STEMI and UA/NSTEMI subgroups.

criticisms.text: FDA considered the genotype analysis exploratory due to differences in event risks between the genetic subset and the overall trial.
criticisms.quote: Because of the differences in event risks between the genetic subset and the overall trial, the FDA considered the analysis of such data to be exploratory, but worthy of further study [24].
